articles.summary: Ollama now supports speech models, starting with Phonon from Gradium. Read text aloud in five languages and dozens of voices, streamed as it is generated, over 100 times faster than real time on Apple Silicon.
articles.title: Speech models in Ollama

articles.summary: Clef, a 27B multimodal decision model from Cloudflare, is now available on Ollama. Run it locally or on Ollama's cloud.
articles.title: Clef is available on Ollama's cloud

articles.summary: AI agents can now use Ollama's cloud models safely inside Fly.io's cloud computers.
articles.title: Run AI agents safely with Ollama and Fly.io

articles.summary: Reflection's first open-weight model is now available on Ollama, and free for a limited time only. Beam is designed for software engineering, reasoning, and long-running agentic tasks. Access Beam through Ollama Cloud.
articles.title: Reflection's Beam is freely available on Ollama for a limited time
